'''2016 Worlds Day 3 Reid Smith DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|Imperial Entanglements]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125623/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
